self.title: Cycle 35 · Predictive Information and Dissipation Bounds in Nonequilibrium Systems

detail.title: Predictive Information and Dissipation Bounds in Nonequilibrium Systems
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates thermodynamic dissipation bounds in information engines and nonequilibrium systems, examining how entropy production rates and coarse-graining constraints relate to predictive information using collected evidence.
